'''Teubbo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Economist/Legends|economist]] who was recruited by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] into allying with him after the latter had established [[Zsinj's Empire|his own empire]] following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] splintering at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Teubbo is a new character; on one level, the image of a Hutt intellectual matches the eccentric image of Zsinj's regime &ndash; but underneath that, the ruthless logic of supply-side economics and the ''kajidic'' patronage network of the Hutts both connect with elements of Zsinj's own approach to power.|Paul R. Urquhart|<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25851092826/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-13|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 13}}</ref>}}
Teubbo was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> In the endnotes to ''The Essential Guide for Warfare'', Urquhart remarked on how the character, a Hutt economist, was intended to fit with the atmosphere of Zsinj's Empire, both in terms of the bizarre image Zsinj's Empire projected and the ruthless efficiency of Zsinj's approach to power.<ref name="Tumblr" />
